claims.text: MAOIs prolong and intensify its anticholinergic (drying) effects.
claims.quote: MAO inhibitors prolong and intensify the anticholinergic (drying) effects of antihistamines.

claims.text: Overdose: CNS depression or stimulation (stimulation esp. in children);
claims.quote: Antihistamine overdosage reactions may vary from central nervous system depression to stimulation. Stimulation is particularly likely in pediatric patients.

claims.text: atropine-like signs (dry mouth, fixed dilated pupils, flushing, GI symptoms);
claims.quote: Atropine-like signs and symptoms, dry mouth; fixed, dilated pupils; flushing, and gastrointestinal symptoms may also occur.

claims.text: can cause hallucinations, convulsions or death.
claims.quote: overdosage may cause hallucinations, convulsions or death.
